name: Flux Kontex
description: Black Forest Labs - Context-aware variant built for extra-long descriptive prompts Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Push toward 220+ words with exhaustive scene breakdowns and cross-subject relationships.
detail_expectation: Stack contextual storytelling, environmental cues, and emotional subtext for every subject.
avoid: Repeating the same adjective without adding information
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, watermark, text artifacts
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Flux Kontex-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
